newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Aug 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times business - Aug 18.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following business stories Monday:
* Small investors are unphased by the U.S. stock market's plunge Friday.
* Some broadcasters say they are prepared to abandon pledges they made to broadcast high-definition programming on second channels.
* UPN and WB are battling it out to become the last broadcast network.
* A survey found that advertising agencies and their clients have better relationships today than in the past.
* Geron said it cloned a gene that could potentialy aid the fight against cancer.
* Xerox will introduce its first household product.
* IBM will announce a faster version of its AS/400 minicomputer.
Netscape said it will unbundle its Web-browser software.
